measurement: These liners are universal fit and require no circumference measurement. Step 1: Choose Calf or Thigh to match the shell being replaced on your brace. Step 2: Select configuration, Right Lateral/Left Medial (RL/LM) or Right Medial/Left Lateral (RM/LL), to match your Rebound Cartilage brace. If unsure, check the label on your existing brace or contact for assistance. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee.
